query: INSERT INTO item_notes (id, document_id, user_id, body, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $5) ON CONFLICT (user_id, document_id) WHERE document_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET body = EXCLUDED.body, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE $6::timestamptz IS NULL OR date_trunc('milliseconds', item_notes.updated_at) <= date_trunc('milliseconds', $6::timestamptz) RETURNING id, document_id AS "document_id!", user_id, body, created_at, updated_at
